stem: How did the War of 1812 most affect the U.S. economy?

options.label: A
options.text: Disruption in trade contributed to domestic industrial growth.

options.label: B
options.text: Small farmers benefited from higher export prices for grain crops.

options.label: C
options.text: The sale of treasury bonds to international companies was prohibited.

options.label: D
options.text: New trade alliances resulted in increased foreign investment.

visual_elements: Question text with four answer choices labeled A, B, C, D
